Frequently asked

Outsourced SDR questions

The practical details that separate a managed SDR team from generic appointment setting.

Is outreach phone-only?

Telephone outreach is a core strength, but the program can combine phone, email, and LinkedIn follow-up based on the market, contact seniority, and campaign strategy.

Do SDRs use a fixed script?

Messaging frameworks and call preparation create consistency, but calls are not treated as one-size-fits-all scripts. Representatives are expected to respond to the account, role, context, and live conversation.

Who builds the target account and contact lists?

Capital Generations provides data support for account selection, contact identification, list maintenance, segmentation, and cleansing, aligned to the agreed ideal customer profile.

What happens when an SDR is underperforming?

Management includes coaching, KPI review, call feedback, and accountability. Capital Generations also owns the people-management responsibility, including replacement when necessary.

How are meetings handled after they are booked?

The team schedules and confirms the meeting, records relevant context, supports the handoff, and tracks whether the meeting was held, rescheduled, canceled, or missed.
